تفتحلوا (form VIII)
# تَفْتَحِلُوا (taftaḥilū) /taf.ta.ħi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# تُفْتَحَلُوا (tuftaḥalū) /tuf.ta.ħa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
